verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a browser-automation framework, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only single-call primitives: act/extract/observe operate on one instruction at a time, and the autonomous agent runs multi-step workflows. Nothing shows batch or bulk actions across many items, such as acting on every matched element or running parallel jobs over a list. Agent workflows and WebMCP's 'one call instead of six clicks' are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.
